acceptance: Reproduce the live failure where supervisor assistant_dev_bridge.last_result reports ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pydantic while a pending packet remains undrained.
Reproduce the local drain failure where signed bridge dispatch using a non-operator actor makes ai_status.py assign fail with status command lease required for auto worker.

Define the correct signed DevTaskPacket actor/admission contract: repo-local verified bridge assignment must not require an auto-worker lease, and untrusted direct worker mutations must still require leases.
Supervisor auto drain processes a fresh signed packet into processed plus a durable assistant-dev-bridge admission record without manual drain.
Regression tests cover import path/dependency availability, actor/lease behavior, replay safety, and exact materialized task provenance.
Repair is delivered through task branch, PR, visible checks, Codex2 review, merge, and then safe runtime refresh sequencing; no manual task-board JSON edits.
task_spec.summary: Fix the dev bridge reliability defects discovered while dispatching the release-platform batch: supervisor auto drain stayed unavailable on pydantic import, and local drain failed because bridge actor identity was treated as an auto worker without ORCH_RUN_ID.
task_spec.title: Repair supervisor DevTaskPacket drain and bridge actor admission
